scope: current Binance bounded-session acceptance; no measured economic result

required_dated_inputs: causal market observations and publication/availability timestamps

dated quantity/price rules, leverage brackets, maintenance margin and liquidation costs
dated executable CNY/USDT conversions including conversion costs

legacy_benchmark.scope: immutable historical comparisons only; not current session acceptance
